guidance.procedure: Map actor, modality, action, object, trigger, condition, exception, quantifier and governing definition. Request-only disposition does not establish return at termination; retention permission does not establish disposition. An end-triggered duty covers it, while an all-copies/all-forms return-or-destroy duty opposes retention absent an express carve-out. Cite every operative split and independent repetition, including duplicated provisions, but not headings, recitals, certifications or nearby context. Independent development and third-party receipt require distinct permission or exclusion language; a development ban or third-party clause cannot substitute for the other. Nontechnical protected categories oppose technical-only; oral, any-form or intangible language supports oral coverage. Universal identification follows when protection is conditioned on marking or notice; under this annotation convention, preserving confidentiality legends on every authorized copy also counts, while optional marking does not. Nonemployee sharing requires operative permission; employee-only access plus a general third-party ban opposes it, as do consent-only permissions. Agreement confidentiality includes existence, terms, negotiations, identities and deal arrangements; narrow compelled-disclosure exceptions do not reverse the restriction. No-solicitation requires broad no-contact language or employee solicit, hire or induce restrictions; exclude customer and noncompete provisions. Ownership, reserved rights and no-license clauses support no-license; under this benchmark, a narrow evaluation license with reserved ownership does not negate it—cite grant, reservation and ownership. Copy permission needs an operative exception, including reproduction expressly allowed elsewhere; consent-only bans oppose. During-and-after duties, continuing obligations or retained copies remaining bound establish survival. Absolute design, development or manufacture use bans can support reverse-engineering.

For each hypothesis independently align actor, modality, action, object, quantifier, trigger, conditions, exceptions and governing definitions. Silence or a neighboring topic is unresolved; never infer permission from absence, a trigger from mere survival, or one relationship from another. Select every original member needed to express the governing rule, operative clause, exception or independently responsive repetition. Exclude headings, recitals, certifications and merely adjacent provisions.

operations.rationale: Replaces the packed topic checklist with a broadly applicable relation-and-membership audit; scoped distinctions are separated below.

guidance.procedure: Separate the disposition trigger from its remedy. A request-only clause does not establish disposition at agreement end; completion, discontinued dealings or termination must be linked to return or destruction. Because “some” is existential, disposition of a covered subset supports even if another subset may be kept. Retention requires an affirmative archive, backup, recordkeeping or similar carve-out; an all-copies or no-retention command opposes it. Cite the trigger, remedy and operative carve-out when jointly controlling.

operations.rationale: Corrects confusion between request-only and end-linked duties, and between partial disposition and express retention.

guidance.procedure: Support survival only when an identified obligation expressly continues after termination, has a post-termination period, or remains binding for retained material. A term provision, possible later end date or generic survival exception without a continuing duty is insufficient. Cite each independently responsive continuing obligation, not a generic term clause substituted for it.

operations.rationale: Separates operative post-termination duties from mere duration language and improves repeated-member selection.

guidance.procedure: Resolve definition hypotheses from all alternative inclusion routes. Express nontechnical categories oppose technical-only coverage; do not treat a technical example as an exclusive definition. Oral coverage requires an express oral, verbal or spoken route, not an inference from broad information language or unspecified form. Universal identification fails when content, circumstances, implication or an automatic category can qualify information without designation, marking or notice. Cite the governing introduction and each operative route needed to show the boundary.

operations.rationale: Targets recurring definition errors caused by examples, inferred oral coverage and overlooked alternative confidentiality routes.

guidance.procedure: Independent development requires an express permission or exclusion for development by the receiving party; development or disclosure by other actors does not substitute, and silence remains unresolved. Third-party acquisition requires an express lawful or nonconfidential-source route, with any no-duty or authorization conditions preserved. Cite the governing exclusion introduction plus the responsive subclause, including independently repeated definitions.

operations.rationale: Addresses repeated false permissions from silence and actor confusion while preserving governing exclusion members.

guidance.procedure: Require an operative standing permission to disclose to the relevant class, together with need-to-know, purpose or confidentiality conditions. A definition of representatives alone is not permission. Prior-consent-only language or a blanket third-party ban opposes sharing under this annotation convention; silence is unresolved. Evaluate employees separately from consultants, agents, advisers and other nonemployees, and cite both the class definition and operative permission when both govern.

operations.rationale: Distinguishes operative permissions from definitions and consent-only bans, and prevents employee/nonemployee substitution.

guidance.procedure: A no-rights or no-license clause, reserved ownership, or exclusive-property provision supports no-license. Permission to receive, evaluate, use or disclose information does not itself grant a proprietary right and does not oppose no-license. A positive license must cover the confidential information or its rights; a license concerning separate marks, products or services is not responsive. Cite independent ownership and reservation provisions when each is annotated as governing.

operations.rationale: Prevents disclosure permissions and unrelated licenses from being mistaken for grants while retaining ownership-based support.

guidance.procedure: A prohibition on revealing the agreement’s existence, exchanged material, discussions, negotiations, terms, conditions or status supports agreement confidentiality; keep its polarity as support for the prohibitory hypothesis. A confidentiality duty covering only substantive information, an enforcement notice, or an entire-agreement clause does not settle this issue. Preserve separately operative listed aspects as evidence members.

operations.rationale: Corrects polarity reversals and reliance on unrelated confidentiality or boilerplate provisions.

guidance.procedure: Require a restriction on soliciting, hiring, inducing or recruiting the disclosing party’s employees, officers or other representatives. Restrictions on contacting customers, suppliers, business sources, transaction counterparties or designated contacts do not substitute, nor does a general noncompete. Preserve scope limitations and recruiting or general-advertisement exceptions without treating them as elimination of the operative restriction.

operations.rationale: Separates representative solicitation from business-source and no-contact restrictions.

guidance.procedure: Copy permission requires an affirmative operative allowance; do not infer it from silence or from a qualification within a reproduction ban. An express copying, reproduction or retention prohibition opposes copy permission, while an express exception supports it. Reverse-engineering restrictions require that act or functionally specified disassembly or decompilation; ordinary copying and use limits are insufficient. Absolute design, development or manufacture use bans can support reverse-engineering when they functionally cover that conduct.

operations.rationale: Scopes copying and reverse engineering separately while retaining the previously useful functional-ban distinction.

guidance.procedure: Require an affirmative notice duty tied to disclosure compelled by law, regulation, subpoena, judicial process or governmental demand. Notice of an unauthorized breach is not responsive. Preserve qualifications such as legal permission, practicability and advance timing. Cite the governing compelled-disclosure exception, the notice command, and any linked opportunity-to-object language that independently defines the duty.

operations.rationale: Distinguishes compelled-disclosure notice from breach notice and addresses omitted governing and linked members.

guidance.procedure: Support limited use only from an operative restriction tying use of confidential information to stated, agreed, evaluation or transaction purposes. A nondisclosure rule, a limit on what information may be requested, or a restriction concerning separate marks or products does not substitute. Cite independently operative repetitions and any governing introduction that supplies the protected object or permitted purpose.

operations.rationale: Corrects recurring substitution of disclosure, collection and unrelated-use clauses for confidential-information use limits.
